gloss: lifting a ban; removal of a prohibition

definitions.gloss: lifting a ban; removal of a prohibition; unbanning
definitions.explanation: The act of removing or canceling a previously imposed prohibition or restriction. Used in legal, regulatory, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Calls to lift the travel ban are growing louder.

examples.japanese: ⟦アカウント→アカウント：05103_akaunto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{禁止解除|きんしかいじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧はどう⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How do I go about getting my account unbanned?

notes:
Compound of ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition) + ⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧ (cancellation/removal). Can be used as a single compound noun or as two separate words (⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: to lift a ban (verb phrase)
- {禁止解除|きんしかいじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to demand the lifting of a ban
- ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧{禁止解除|きんしかいじょ}: lifting of an import ban
- ⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧{禁止解除|きんしかいじょ}: complete lifting of a ban

USAGE:
In modern usage, {禁止解除|きんしかいじょ} also appears in digital contexts such as account unbanning on social media, lifting of content restrictions, and unlocking features in games.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解禁|かいきん}→解禁：14144_kaikin⟧: lifting of a ban — more concise synonym; often used for seasonal bans (fishing, hunting) and product release dates
- ⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧: cancellation; removal — broader term for removing any restriction, not just prohibitions
- ⟦{撤廃|てっぱい}→撤廃：12911_teppai⟧: abolition; repeal — stronger; implies permanent removal of a law or system
- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧: relaxation; easing — partial loosening of restrictions rather than full removal
